resolutions.researcher_notes: Value 'operating' supported. petro-news.com (Egyptian petroleum trade outlet, '39-project natural-gas map') states the Noubaria-Mit Nama line was completed Feb 2015 to feed the North Giza power station; presidency.eg (Egypt's official national-projects register) lists both phases as executed (completed ~Nov 2015). Two independent origins agree the line is built and in service -> operating confirmed by context. NOTE: the brief's current_ref (petro-news.com/95212/) was classed DEAD_LINK but is a FALSE dead-link -- it returns 200 and contains النوبارية; retained as a valid ref.

CONTRADICTION: GEM LengthKnown=66 km is NOT supported by any source found. Three independent sources -- petro-news.com, presidency.eg, and egy-map.com -- all give a two-phase total of 72 km (Phase 1 = 42" x 34 km, Phase 2 = 32" x 38 km; 34+38=72). The 2010/2011 pre-construction ESIAs (EIB eib.org/files/pipeline/20100121_esia_en.pdf and World Bank E28180) describe the ORIGINAL single 32" design at 105 km (a different, longer routing). No source states 66 km. Recommend Update correct LengthKnown 66 -> 72 (as-built) or re-verify. Left UNRESOLVED because no working ref supports the stated value 66.

Value 'Diameter=32, 42 in' fully supported. petro-news.com and presidency.eg both give Phase 1 = 42" (34 km) and Phase 2 = 32" (38 km); egy-map.com corroborates the same two diameters. The multi-value '32, 42' matches the two phases exactly. Two independent origins.

The FuelSource cell value is itself the egy-map.com project URL (a mis-mapped cell -- FuelSource normally names a gas field, not a URL). Verified that URL is live (200) and contains النوبارية / ميت نما plus the phase 32/34/38/42 figures, i.e. it is a working page describing this pipeline. Cite the egy-map page as the supporting/self ref. egy-map is a projects aggregator that restates presidency.eg, so treat as low/dependent; flag the cell mapping for review.

Endpoints supported: StartLocation El Noubareya -> EndLocation Mit Nama, Egypt. World Bank ESIA (E28180, English) titles the project 'El Nubariya – Metnama' and describes the route from Nubaria power station south to link the existing El Teena-Metnama line; presidency.eg confirms the Noubaria->Mit Nama routing feeding North Giza power station. GEM StartState 'Behara' (Beheira, where Noubaria/New Nubaria sits) and EndState 'Al Qalyubia' (where Mit Nama/Metnama sits) are geographically consistent. Two independent origins (WB English + presidency Arabic).

Value SegmentCost=1,197,000,000 EGP supported: petro-news.com and presidency.eg both state the combined two-phase cost as 1.197 billion Egyptian pounds; egy-map.com corroborates. Matches the stored 1197000000 EGP. (SegmentCostYear blank in GEM; project completed 2015.) Two independent origins.

Owner1='Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Co' (EGAS) 100% supported. The EIB Nubaria-Metnama ESIA is submitted to 'The Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company' (EGAS) and the World Bank E28180 ESIA identifies EGAS as the holding company with GASCO (Egyptian Natural Gas Co) carrying out implementation. So EGAS is owner; GASCO is the operator/implementer (not the Owner field). Two independent English primary sources.
